source_anchor: Hoffmann et al. 2022 "Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models" (Chinchilla) §3 + Eq. 4; arXiv:2203.15556
prompt_text: Chinchilla compute-optimal model size: under the simplified relation N_opt = sqrt(C / 6), where C is total training compute in FLOPs and 6 is the FLOPs-per-parameter-token constant from Kaplan/Hoffmann. For C = 6e21 FLOPs, print N_opt as scientific notation to 4-decimal mantissa precision (e.g. via toExponential(4)).

candidate_responses.text: CORRECT: names the FLOPs-per-param-token constant flops_per_param_token, uses Math.sqrt.
candidate_responses.code: const compute=6e21; const flops_per_param_token=6; const N_opt=Math.sqrt(compute/flops_per_param_token); console.log(N_opt.toExponential(4));

candidate_responses.text: WRONG: drops the divide-by-6 (the FLOPs/parameter/token constant) and sqrts the raw compute.
CARGO-CULT: Chinchilla / flops_per_param_token / N_opt / Math.pow / toExponential present, but takes the CUBE root instead of the square root.
candidate_responses.code: const C=6e21; const flops_per_param_token=6; const N_opt=Math.pow(C/flops_per_param_token, 1/3); console.log(N_opt.toExponential(4));
